New jobs save args.json and initialize ckpt/job.json with next_module_idx=0 and surplus_bits=0. Module is a custom abstract base, not a torch.nn.Module subclass. It registers children explicitly, recursively loads and unloads them, traverses itself before descendants, and aggregates quantization labels and weight counts. prepare_for_device moves an activation to the module's device. Model.forward runs top-level modules sequentially under inference_mode, mov\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"generation\", \"title\": \"Dynamic generation, paged KV ownership and streaming contracts\", \"focus\": \"Job accepts one CPU token tensor of shape (1, n), or a list of such sequences sampled collectively. Token healing removes the final prompt token when every sequence has more than one token, restricts the first sample by its prefix and excludes the healed prefix from emitted tex\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"sampling\", \"title\": \"Composable sampling, Gumbel noise and native matching\", \"focus\": \"CustomSampler.forward accepts logits, optional sequence IDs, a 32-bit seed, a tokenizer and blocked/allowed token lists. It flattens all leading logit dimensions into rows, runs the sampling steps and reshapes the selected IDs back to the original leading shape. sequence_ids is accepted but unused here. This is the local interface to generation; tokenizer.actual_vocab_size supplies the boundary fo\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"loading-tokenization\", \"title\": \"Loading tensors and translating text\", \"focus\": \"SafetensorsCollection scans *.safetensors directly rather than consulting an index JSON. read_header reads an eight-byte NumPy int64 header length, parses the following UTF-8 JSON and records the payload start. Metadata entries are excluded from the key-to-file map; later scanned files replace duplicate keys. get_tensor translates payload-relative data_offsets into absolute file offsets and assert\", \"focus_source\": \"authored_claim_excerpt\", \"focus_truncated\": true}, {\"id\": \"runtime\", \"title\": \"Runtime initialization, native interfaces and storage utilities\", \"focus\": \"The package initializer re-exports Config, Model, Tokenizer, cache classes, synchronous/asynchronous generation classes and samplers.
